title: Return a JSON list
summary: Phoenix: Return a JSON list. Add a third title.
introduction: A map can wrap a list under a clear key. Open GET /books. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a JSON list with Phoenix

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Return a JSON list
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/books", LessonController, :books
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def books(conn, _params), do: json(conn, %{books: ["Moon Trip", "Sun Trip"]})
end

blocks.text: The response map wraps two titles under books. json serialises that list.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the response shape consistent for clients.
